_comment: Payload fields Mordred plugins consume per Hermes hook. Keys must match exactly the hooks registered by mordred_hermes plugins (tests/test_hook_payload_drift.py enforces this); values are the sorted kwargs the handlers read. Consumers: network/hooks.py on_session_start (session_id), privacy_check + network pre_tool_call (tool_name), llm_guard + network pre_api_request (base_url, provider), and extension/gateway_plugin.py pre_gateway_dispatch (event, gateway). on_session_end only needs the hook to fire.
